title: bug: CBOR skip integer underflow on buflen-pos subtraction
description: RECLASSIFIED from P0 bug: the underflow does not occur in current code. cbor_read_head returning a positive head guarantees pos+head<=buflen (each branch checks this before returning), so buflen-pos-head cannot underflow. However, the formulation at line 410 depends on that two-level invariant, while lines 301/339 use a safer single-level form. This is now tracked as a style/consistency fix in wolfP11-ww0b. This bead is superseded by wolfP11-ww0b; keeping for audit trail.
